title: STEMEd+ Professional Development: a program
description: One national professional development program for STEM+ educators, with any announced sessions or application rounds. One file per program in programs/. Who it can be for: K-12 teachers; informal educators (museums, zoos, aquariums, parks, nature centers, libraries, after-school, and outreach); college and university faculty and instructors; and graduate students and postdocs preparing to teach. List only programs run by a national scholarly or professional society or association (US or international), by a US federal agency, by a national program funded by a US federal agency, by the Smithsonian Institution, or by a national private foundation or nonprofit, and open to people from many schools or institutions. Not listed: state, regional, and district programs; programs a single campus runs for its own people; programs run by companies; conferences (those belong on STEMEd+ Conferences). If you are not sure a program meets this rule, leave it out.

name.description: Program name as the provider gives it.

providers.description: The societies, associations, or agencies that run or fund it.

sponsor_type.description: US society: a national US scholarly or professional society or association. International society: one organized internationally. US federal agency: run by NOAA, NASA, NSF, NPS, the Department of Energy, or another US agency. Federally funded program: a national program run by another organization with US federal funding (say how in funding_note). Smithsonian Institution: a Smithsonian museum or center. Private foundation or nonprofit: a national program run or funded by a private foundation or nonprofit (not a company), open to educators across the US.

funding_note.description: Which agency supports it and how.

type.description: research: a research experience in a lab or field team. field: a field, ship, or park experience. fellowship: a selective paid placement or multi-year cohort program. institute: an in-person or live workshop or institute. course: an online or blended course. webinars: a series of live or recorded webinars. network: a mentoring network or community of practice. coaching: coaching or mentoring. credential: a certificate program or certification training. departmental: a workshop brought to your department or campus. postdoc: a teaching postdoc or teaching fellowship.

audiences.description: Who it is for. Informal educators: museum, zoo, aquarium, park, nature center, library, after-school, and outreach educators. Faculty and instructors: anyone teaching college or university courses, including lecturers, adjuncts, two-year college faculty, and teaching-focused faculty. Graduate students and postdocs: those preparing to teach in college.

grades.description: For programs open to K-12 teachers: grade bands it is designed for. Leave empty if it is for all of K-12.

disciplines.description: Labels from the STEMEd+ discipline list (stemed_pd/stemedplus_disciplines.json, kept in stemedplus-theme). Leave empty for programs open to all STEM+ fields. Computer science is listed under Engineering; statistics under Mathematics.

cost.description: free: no cost to participants. stipend: no cost, and participants are paid or have travel covered. members: free for members of the society. fee: participants or their schools pay. varies: depends on the session or host.

cost_note.description: Amounts, what is covered, or member prices, in a sentence.

credit.description: Graduate credit, certificates of hours, or certification, in a sentence.

url.description: The provider's page for the program.

status.description: paused: the provider says it is not running now.

status_note.description: Why it is paused and when the provider expects news.

schedule.description: When it usually happens and when applications are usually due, in a sentence.

summary.description: Who it is for and what participants do, in your own words.

checked.description: When someone last checked this file against the provider's pages.

notes.description: Notes for maintainers; not shown on the site.

offerings.description: Announced sessions, cohorts, or application rounds. Past ones may stay; the site hides them once every date has passed.

dates_source.description: official: the dates are on the provider's own page for this offering. announced: the provider gave a month or season, or a partner announced it.

label.description: e.g. Applications open, Applications due, Registration closes.

career.description: For programs open to faculty, instructors, graduate students, or postdocs: career stages it is designed for. Leave empty if it is open to any stage.

institutions.description: Which institutions or departments can take part, if limited (e.g. two-year colleges, member institutions, US institutions).
